key_facts: July 10 check (T+1d, unchanged): Seattle Times (July 9) and Field Level Media (July 10) corroborated the Front Office Sports report that the Seahawks sale ($8B-$10B+ estimate) is down to two front-running finalists following the June 29 first-round bid deadline: (1) Aditya Mittal & Wyc Grousbeck group and (2) Vinod Khosla group (who would divest his 3.1% 49ers stake if selected). Todd Boehly (no longer in the running) and Steve Apostolopoulos (withdrew) are out; Steve Ballmer has not been named as a suitor, though one FOS source noted a surprise late swooper remains possible. Vulcan LLC (Paul G. Allen Estate) stated there is no news to share, and FOS reported an update is expected by next month. No official agreement or NFL owners approval announced as of July 10. Held unchanged at 0.42 Mittal/Grousbeck, 0.42 Khosla, 0.04 Bezos, 0.03 Ballmer, 0.02 Boehly (sum 0.93, 0.07 outside for stealth bidder).
next_review_trigger: CRITICAL DAILY CHECK July 11 (T+0d) and onward if unannounced: watch for exclusive buyer selection, signed purchase agreement, NFL Finance Committee recommendation, or NFL owners approval vote.
